organization_name.rationale: Organization name is a header field on the schedule and does not correspond to any canonical leaf element in the IRS990ScheduleL schema.

ein.rationale: EIN is a header field on the schedule and does not correspond to any canonical leaf element in the IRS990ScheduleL schema.

part_i_transactions.rationale: Part I excess benefit transactions map to the DisqualifiedPersonExBnftTrGrp repeating group; the blueprint array corresponds to the group container rather than a single leaf.

part_ii_loans.rationale: Part II loans to/from interested persons map to the LoansBtwnOrgInterestedPrsnGrp repeating group container.

part_ii_total_balance_due.rationale: TotalBalanceDueAmt (row label 'Total ... $') directly represents the totals-line balance due amount at the bottom of the Part II table.

part_iii_grants.rationale: Part III grants/assistance to interested persons map to the GrntAsstBnftInterestedPrsnGrp repeating group container.

part_iv_transactions.rationale: Part IV business transactions involving interested persons map to the BusTrInvolveInterestedPrsnGrp repeating group container.

part_v_supplemental_information.rationale: Blueprint bundles the full Part V narrative into a single string, but the canonical schema splits it into a SupplementalInformationDetail repeating group with separate FormAndLineReferenceDesc and ExplanationTxt children; blueprint should be refactored into an array of objects with form_and_line_reference and explanation_text fields.
